zh.title: 國防部偵獲6艘共艦與7艘公務船於台海周邊活動
zh.summary: 國防部統計25日至今晨偵獲共艦6艘與公務船7艘；期間未發現共機；國軍嚴密監控
body: 中華民國國防部發布最新中共軍機與軍艦動態統計指出，自2026年8月25日上午6時至8月26日上午6時止，國軍於台灣海峽周邊海域偵獲中共軍艦6艘次，以及中共公務船7艘次持續活動。在此24小時監控期間內，軍方並未偵獲任何中共軍機出沒。
面對台海周邊動態，國防部強調，國軍持續運用任務航空器、海軍艦艇及岸置飛彈系統等兵力，進行嚴密監控與即時應處，以掌握相關海空域狀況。
此外，依據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於8月24日之監控數據中，曾記錄到中共軍機2架次、軍艦7艘次及公務船2艘次於周邊活動。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 6 PLA Vessels and 7 Official Ships Near Island
en.summary: Taiwan detected six PLA vessels and seven official ships; no military aircraft were reported; monitoring deployed.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its daily military movement report, stating that six Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) naval vessels and seven official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 06:00 on August 25 and 06:00 on August 26, 2026. No PLA aircraft were detected during the 24-hour monitoring window.
The defense ministry stated that Taiwan's armed forces closely monitored the situation and responded by deploying mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
According to site statistical records, previous monitoring on August 24 recorded two PLA aircraft, seven PLA vessels, and two official ships operating in the vicinity.
